ProgramUnit.Name: CLEAR_DETAILS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
procedure clear_details ( detail char, master char, opt number ) is
begin
--message('go block'||detail);
 go_block(detail);
 check_package_failure;
 if :system.block_status = 'CHANGED' then
 clear_block(no_validate);
 if :system.block_status = 'CHANGED' then
 go_block(master);
 raise FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 end if;
 end if;
--message('clear block'||detail);
 clear_block(no_validate);
 check_package_failure;
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: CLEAR_ORDER_DETAILS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
procedure clear_order_details ( checkmaster boolean, opt number ) is
begin
 if ( not checkmaster
 or ((:order.CHAPTER_ID is not null)
 or (:order.ORDER_NO is not null)) )
 then
 clear_details('order_status', 'order', opt);
 end if ;
 if ( (:order.CHAPTER_ID is not null)
 or (:order.ORDER_NO is not null) )
 then
 clear_details('order_items', 'order', opt);
 go_block('order_items');
 --message('before clear items detail');
 clear_order_items_details(true,no_validate);
 --message('after clear items detail');
 end if;
 --message('note_id= ' || to_char(:order.note_id));
 if ( (:order.NOTE_ID is not null) ) then
 go_block('note');
 clear_block(no_validate);
 go_block('order');
 clear_details('note', 'order', opt);
 end if;
 if ( (:order.ORDER_NO is not null)
 or (:order.CHAPTER_ID is not null) )
 then
 clear_details('pick_slips', 'order', opt);
 go_block('pick_slips');
 clear_pick_slips_details(true,no_validate);
 go_block('psp');
 clear_pick_slip_produc_details(true,no_validate);
 end if;
 go_block('order');
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: QUERY_DETAILS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
procedure query_details ( detail char ) is
begin
 go_block(detail);
 check_package_failure;
 :system.message_level := 5;
 execute_query;
 :system.message_level := 0;
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: QUERY_ORDER_DETAILS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
procedure query_order_details is
begin
 if ( (:order.CHAPTER_ID is not null) or
 (:order.ORDER_NO is not null) and
 :system.record_status != 'NEW' ) then
 query_details('order_status');
 end if;
 if ( (:order.CHAPTER_ID is not null) or
 (:order.ORDER_NO is not null) ) then
 query_details('order_items');
 go_block('order_items');
 query_order_items_details;
 end if;
 if ( (:order.NOTE_ID is not null) ) then
 query_details('note');
 end if;
 if ( (:order.ORDER_NO is not null)
 or (:order.CHAPTER_ID is not null) )
 then
 query_details('pick_slips');
 go_block('pick_slips');
 if :pick_slips.pick_slip_id is not null
 then
 query_pick_slips_details;
 end if;
 go_block('psp');
 if :psp.unit_id is not null
 then
 query_pick_slip_produc_details;
 end if;
 end if;
 go_block('order');
end;

Trigger.Name: ON-ERROR
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 temp_code number;
 temp_msg VARCHAR2(80);
begin
 if error_code = 40100 -- at first record
 then
 show_error_dist('0213');
 elsif error_code = 40102 -- record must be entered first
 then
 show_error_dist('0214');
 elsif error_code = 40200 -- field protected against update
 then
 show_error_dist('0215');
 elsif error_code = 40201 -- field is full
 then
 show_error_dist('0216');
 elsif error_code = 40202 -- field must be entered
 then
 show_error_dist('0204');
 elsif error_code = 40207 -- must be in range
 then
 show_error_dist('0217');
 elsif error_code = 40208 -- form in query mode, cant update
 then
 show_error_dist('0218');
 elsif error_code = 40209 -- invalid entry format
 then
 show_error_dist('0246');
 elsif error_code = 40200 -- field protected against update
 then
 show_error_dist('0215');
 elsif error_code in (40400,40406,40407)-- transaction committed
 then
 show_error_dist('0000');
 elsif error_code = 40401 -- no changes to commit
 then
 show_error_dist('0601');
 elsif error_code in (50002,50003,50004, -- invalid date
 50011,50012,50021,50023,50026,0)
 then
 declare
 disp_format_mask varchar2(20);
 begin
 if upper(substr(get_item_property(:system.cursor_item, FORMAT_MASK),1,2))='FX' then
 disp_format_mask:=substr(get_item_property(:system.cursor_item, FORMAT_MASK),3);
 else
 disp_format_mask:= get_item_property(:system.cursor_item, FORMAT_MASK);
 end if;
 disp_format_mask := translate(disp_format_mask, 'R', 'Y');
 show_error_dist('0251',disp_format_mask);
 show_error_dist('0251',GET_ITEM_PROPERTY(:system.cursor_item,FORMAT_MASK));
 end;
 elsif error_code = 50025 -- no changes to commit
 then
 show_error_dist('0509');
 elsif error_code in (50006,50007,50009, -- invalid number
 50013,50014,50015,50016,50020)
 then
 show_error_dist('0220');
 elsif error_code in (50017,50018,50019,50022) -- invalid time
 then
 show_error_dist('0331');
 elsif error_code in ('40209','40735') then
 null;
 else -- unhandled Forms errors
 message('FRMS ' || to_char(error_code) || ':' || error_text);
 end if;
 check_package_failure;
end;
